0022600038.text: The Grizzlies (7-3, 3rd in the Southwest and 7th in the West) visit the Pelicans (4-7, 12th in the West), who have lost three straight, while Memphis has won all five of its road games this season. Memphis is without Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee, surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and New Orleans is missing Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). In the 2026-27 season series the Grizzlies trail 0-1 after a 135-134 loss in Memphis on November 2, and the two teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
